name: diag_t02_cache_six05_08_plan_01
command:
import json,math,os,hashlib,signal
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
signal.alarm(12)
name=os.environ['CVPR_RUN_NAME']; parent='t02_export_cache_six05_08_01'
summaries=['diag_t02_train_six_'+n+'_completed_summary_01' for n in ('05','06','07','08')]
expected=[f'results/t02_export_train_six_05_u{i:04d}.json' for i in (0,1,2,4,5)]
expected += [f'results/{p}_u{i:04d}.json' for p in ('t02_export_train_six_06','t02_export_train_six_07_retry1','t02_export_train_six_08') for i in range(6)]
refs=[]; entries=[]; summaries_refs=[]; kinds={k:0 for k in ('direct_flip','direct_stay','look_flip','look_stay')};unknown={k:0 for k in kinds}
for n in summaries:
 d,r=audited_result('results/'+n+'.json');assert d['_meta']['exit_code']==0
 refs.append(r);summaries_refs.append(r);m=d['metrics']; entries+=m['cache_source_results']
 for k in kinds:kinds[k]+=m['complete_by_kind'].get(k,0);unknown[k]+=m['unknown_or_rejected_by_kind'].get(k,0)
files=[r['file'] if isinstance(r,dict) else r for r in entries];assert files==expected and len(set(files))==23 and sum(kinds.values())==23 and sum(unknown.values())==1
last,lr=audited_result('results/t02_export_cache_remaining24_01.json');refs.append(lr)
assert last['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and last['metrics']['cache_matches_live'] is True and len(last['metrics']['population_ledger'])==24
timeout=math.ceil(last['_meta']['duration_sec']*1.3*len(files)/24);wall=timeout+30;walltime=f'{wall//3600:02d}:{wall%3600//60:02d}:{wall%60:02d}'
cmd=['python3','-u','-m','src.tools.t02_cache_check','--name',parent]
for f in files:cmd+=['--source',f]
cmd+=['--sample-size','200','--seed','0','--timeout-seconds',str(timeout),'--pair-timeout-seconds','180','--gate-timeout-seconds','180']
config={'status':'fixed_cutoff_pending_cache','name':parent,'source':files,'complete_source_refs_from_original_summaries':entries,'all_four_original_attempt_summaries':summaries_refs,'original_attempt_count':24,'unknown_source':'results/t02_export_train_six_05_u0003.json','complete_counts_pending_cache':kinds,'unknown_counts_preserved':unknown,'sample_size':200,'seed':0,'timeout_seconds':timeout,'walltime':walltime,'engineering_request_basis':{'measured_source':lr,'duration_seconds':last['_meta']['duration_sec'],'original_population_pairs':24,'new_complete_population_pairs':23,'margin':1.3,'pbs_extra_seconds':30,'scope':'engineering walltime reservation only, not observed cost or expected speedup'},'command':cmd,'submission_command':['python3','scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py','--name',parent,'--task','T01','--gpus','1','--walltime',walltime,'--budget-group','T02','--',*cmd],'no_population_replacement_after_sampling':True,'full_training_authorization':False}
p=Path('configs/t02_cache_six05_08_fixed.json');p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);p.open('x').write(json.dumps(config,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n');p.chmod(0o444)
m={'status':'fixed_cutoff_ready','config':{'file':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'complete_pairs_pending_cache':len(files),'counts_pending_cache':kinds,'unknown_retained':unknown,'requested_walltime':walltime,'requested_gpu_hours_upper_bound':wall/3600,'sample_size':200}
Path('results',name+'.json').write_text(json.dumps({'metrics':m,'config':{'name':name,'scope':'fixed inputs for original full T02 cache checks; no native reread or new acceptance'},'sources':refs},indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(m,sort_keys=True))
